messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: reserved_capacity_high_latency fired for tenant=orchid cluster=orchid-reserved-1. p99 latency > 5s for 3 min. Auto-page to on-call.
pd-bot: PagerDuty: Incident #PD-98765 created and routed to oncall_jen (Escalation policy: eng-oncall). Link: https://pd.example/incidents/PD-98765
oncall_jen: acking — looking now. any customer reports? :eyes:
sre_mike: i see p99 spike + 502 surge in front of orch-reserved-1. KV cache evictions up. routing retries increasing.
oncall_jen: thanks mike. can you dump qps and container stats?
sre_mike: past 10m: requests ~ 4200rps, errors ~ 1.8%, p99 ~ 5.6s. kube node pressure on gpu-3: CPU steal and oom_killer events for sidecars.
eng_runtime_katie: that node has older driver patch that causes context-switch stall with our runtime — we've seen before.
oncall_jen: ok if it's driver-related, we should failover traffic off that node and scale reserved pool. mike, can you trigger drain for gpu-3 and force replica spin-up?
sre_mike: running: `kubectl cordon gpu-node-3 && kubectl drain gpu-node-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

sre_mike: drain started. scheduling shows two new pods on gpu-node-7/gpu-node-9, but warm-up for KV cache will take ~20s.
oncall_jen: initiate fallback policy to hosted variant for affected tenant while we stabilize — eng_runtime_katie take point?
eng_runtime_katie: doing route override: updating routing policy for tenant orchid to prefer hosted: `rwctl routing update --tenant orchid --primary hosted-small --ttl 15m --reason "auto-evacuate gpu-node-3"`

prod_support_ali: notif to customer queued: "Experiencing elevated latency; working on mitigation. Will update in 10m." Sam from CS copied.
customer_success_sam: received. I'll stand by for rollback/confirm when stable.

pd-bot: PD-98765 acknowledged by oncall_jen at 5050000012
oncall_jen: confirming fallback applied. can folks watch p99 and error rate? if p99 back under 1s and errors < 0.1% we'll mark resolved.
sre_mike: after draining, new pods healthy. tailing logs shows fewer 502s. KV cache miss rate falling from 42% -> 7% over 90s. metrics: p99 -> 0.95s, errors -> 0.12%
oncall_jen: good trend. hold for 5m of stability then revert routing change.
eng_runtime_katie: noted. preparing revert command: `rwctl routing revert --tenant orchid --since 5050000000 --confirm-after 300s`

sre_mike: one warn: node gpu-node-5 shows elevated disk io - unrelated but keep an eye. not impacting orchid current traffic.

oncall_jen: thanks team. jen -> mike handoff in 10m if stable; i'll stay until resolved. tagging CS to update customer.
customer_success_sam: updating customer: "We've routed traffic to an alternate capacity while we replace a stressed node. Expect normal latency within minutes. We'll follow up with root cause and timeline."

pd-bot: PD-98765 note: Escalation timer paused — incident currently acknowledged.
oncall_jen: final checks: run a quick smoke against orch tenant: `curl -sS https://api.redwood.ai/serve/orchid -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' -H 'X-Api-Key:REDACTED'` -> 200 OK, rt 320ms.

sre_mike: metrics stable for 6m: p99 0.88s, errors 0.05%, queue depth normalized. KV evictions ~1%.
oncall_jen: reverting routing now.
eng_runtime_katie: revert executed. routing back to reserved cluster and clearing temporary TTL.

prod_support_ali: sent final customer note with timeline + RCA to follow.
customer_success_sam: customer acknowledged and appreciates the quick mitigation.

oncall_jen: marking PD incident resolved after monitoring window. PD resolve command: `pd resolve PD-98765 --note "Mitigation: drained gpu-node-3, routed to hosted for 12m, reverted after stability"`
pd-bot: PD-98765 resolved by oncall_jen at 5050000360

oncall_jen: follow-up tasks: 1) schedule node repro/driver patch with infra (assigned to eng_runtime_katie) 2) add a runaway-driver alert to detect earlier 3) update runbook with quick routing override snippet. I'll open follow-up ticket. thanks all. :thumbsup:
